answer:
根据您提供的 PDF 文档（Mahidol University 的 Wikipedia 写作任务海报），**无法确认** 2016-17 学年哪个 trimester 上传到 Wikimedia Commons 的媒体数量最多。

该文档仅包含以下信息：
- 自 2014 年 9 月起，维基百科写作任务被纳入 Mahidol University International College 的本科化学课程（第 1 页）。
- 共有 103 名学生参与，创建了 56 篇高质量文章，改进了超过 81 篇文章，贡献相当于 364 页书面内容（第 1 页）。
- 参考文献指向 2017 年发表在 *Catalyst* 期刊上的完整论文（Suwannakhan A & Limpanuparb T. 2017），但本 PDF 仅为会议/学术海报，**未包含按学期（trimester）划分的 Wikimedia Commons 媒体上传统计数据**。

如需该详细数据，建议查阅海报中引用的完整期刊论文（*Catalyst* 15(2): 65-79）。

[chunk_4a30d1d60f064d5218c7 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
1Mahidol University International College, Nakhon Pathom 73170 Thailand 2Department of Anatomy, Faculty of Science, Mahidol University, Bangkok 10400 Thailand \*Corresponding author, email: athikhun.suw@student.mahidol.edu

[chunk_688cc62e376cefee52fe page=1 kind=extracted_text]
BACKGROUND

[chunk_e82aae29bee3aec9545b page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Since the founding of Wikipedia in 2001, educators around the world have integrated the free encyclopedia which anyone can edit into their curriculum.

[chunk_86de745af91bd518a8fd page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Educators and students share free knowledge by contributing to Wikipedia and its sister projects in an academic setting.

[chunk_430a2ffe9716613cc3c2 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Writing Wikipedia is an opportunity to teach students 21st century skills that most will use in their careers and personal lives such as information literacy, collaborative skill, and critial thinking.

[chunk_ff0f59e4229b9d9be4a6 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
METHODOLOGY

[chunk_d3438e2beeb4381bf24a page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students were introduced to Wikipedia and its education program in class.

[chunk_2266c8e9924356f96ff5 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Student participation in the program was entirely voluntary.

[chunk_e2386ec211458f7bac46 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students completed online training: 1) The cores of Wikipedia 2) Editing

[chunk_5bacf01695ae92d1c003 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
3) Advanced editing

[chunk_16abda0ef336861cf7ba page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students who did not complete the training were excluded.

[chunk_15842e608245115dc544 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students worked on text and illustration of their article to meet course requirements. - Students’ work was subject to peer review and scrutiny by other Wikipedians.

[chunk_dce46c5ca4090233815d page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students’ contributions were graded quantitatively and qualitatively.

[chunk_93a8085f257002860295 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Exit survey was administered to determine studens’ perception of the program.

[chunk_0a32344ce49ba05085fa page=1 kind=extracted_text]
RESULTS

[chunk_e4615258997cbbc38ae4 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
Students’ contributions

[chunk_c9b805e2e16c29e6461f page=1 kind=extracted_text]
CONCLUSIONS

[chunk_afad1d8619ea041c4f34 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Wikipedia writing assignment has been incorported into undergraduate chemistry classes at Mahidol University International College since September 2014.

[chunk_a83d01645c34c206ee69 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- One hundred and three students participated in the program.

[chunk_f5c3f4b91a1470d25a51 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Fifty six high quality articles were created, and more than 81 articles were improved.

[chunk_925619f88ed739da8b32 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Students’ contrubutions were equivalent

[chunk_af54d3f073783a52b10a page=1 kind=extracted_text]
to 364 written pages.

[chunk_cfc68915881d7336a328 page=1 kind=extracted_text]
\- Wikipedia assignment promotes 21st century skills such as critical thinking, collaboration, and information literacy.

[chunk_c0030cf9117f4754e9cc page=1 kind=extracted_text]
REFERENCE
